create.name: Sufi Earth Spirit (Cala Jami)
create.bio:
Sufi Earth Spirit is a small non-profit association based at Cala Jami, a private valley of olive groves, springs and granite rocks a few kilometres inland from the north-east coast of Sardinia, near San Pantaleo above Olbia. Its founder and president, known as Roshan, has taught meditation for more than three decades and is a representative and retreat guide of the Inayatiyya, the Sufi order of Hazrat Inayat Khan, Pir Vilayat and Pir Zia. The association was set up on the land in 2015.

The idea behind the place is that spiritual practice and care for the earth belong together. Alongside Sufi meditation the valley is farmed organically, and volunteers come through the WWOOF network to work and learn there. On most weekday mornings there is an hour of shared meditation that anyone may join without charge, with an evening Sufi gathering once a week. For those with some experience, Cala Jami hosts solitary retreats through much of the year, following the retreat process taught by Pir Vilayat, with a guide meeting the retreatant each day. Multi-day seminars with visiting Sufi and other teachers take place across the year, and members support the work through a modest yearly subscription. Visits are by appointment only.

courses.title: Membership of Sufi Earth Spirit
courses.description: Yearly membership of the association: news by email, an invitation to the annual meeting at Cala Jami with a free overnight stay, and discounts on events led by Inayatiyya teachers. Valid for one calendar year.

free_resources.title: Daily morning meditations at Cala Jami
free_resources.description: Shared meditation at Cala Jami on most weekdays, Monday to Friday, 7:00 to 8:15 am. Free and open to all; contact the association a couple of days before coming.
